title: Meet the main characters
summary: You play as two leads, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Rockstar has published short bios of them and the people around them. Open the details for that background.

details.summary: Background from Rockstar's official character bios, in brief.
steps: Jason Duval grew up around con artists, did a stint in the Army, and now does work for drug runners in the Keys.
Lucia Caminos was taught to fight by her father. Fighting for her family landed her in Leonida Penitentiary; she's just out and has a plan.
Cal Hampton: Jason's friend, a homebody who listens in on Coast Guard radio and believes every conspiracy online.
Brian Heder: a veteran smuggler in the Keys who lets Jason live in one of his properties in return for help with local jobs.
Boobie Ike: a Vice City figure who turned street money into real estate, a strip club and a recording studio, and co-runs Only Raw Records with Dre'Quan Priest.
Real Dimez (Bae-Luxe and Roxy): a rap duo signed to Only Raw Records, chasing a second hit.
Raul Bautista: an experienced bank robber who recruits people willing to take big risks.

title: GTA+ perks: sell vehicles for more, pay less in shops
summary: If you have a GTA+ membership on console, Rockstar lists optional perks in the story: 10% more money when you sell a vehicle you own, 10% off at many shops, and free or upgraded ways to get around. Skip this if you don't subscribe; nothing in the game requires it.
steps: GTA+ is a paid monthly membership bought through the PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store. It renews automatically until you cancel.
Keep the membership active and play online to claim the perks.
Sell vehicles you own rather than abandoning them: members get a 10% higher sale price.
Buy weapons, clothes, haircuts, tattoos and vehicle mods at participating shops to get the 10% discount.

title: What counts toward 100% completion
summary: You don't have to collect everything. Finishing the story is half of the total, and the rest comes from a spread of crime, exploration and activity targets.
steps: Main story: 50%. All optional missions: 6%.

summary: A timed power-station puzzle that ends with a trip to a recreated 1986 Malibu Club. It rewards Tommy Vercetti's Hawaiian shirt for Jason and Lucia, the Malibu Zombie Bobber motorcycle and its "American Glory" livery.

title: What the wanted star colours mean
summary: Grey stars: a crime was reported and police are on the way with your description, the best moment to leave. White: they've seen you and are chasing. Red: they've lost you but the area is on alert for someone matching you.
steps: White outline: an incident was reported but they don't know who did it.
Red outline: the area is on alert, but you no longer match the description.
If you're unarmed, officers often use Tasers first. Pull a gun and they respond in kind.

title: Clear your heat icons to shake the police
summary: The icons under your stars show how the police can recognise you. Clear each one and they lose track of you.
steps: Appearance: change accessories or your hairstyle (wear a mask for planned jobs so you never get this one).
Vehicle: switch cars or get it resprayed.
Outfit: change clothes. Keeping a spare outfit in your trunk helps.
Visible weapon: holster sidearms; longarms go in the trunk or get dropped.
Partner: split up, or switch to your partner and change their look.
CCTV camera icon: destroy the footage. Cloud icon: it can't be destroyed, so just get away.

title: Use Focus mode to spot loot and threats
summary: Click both sticks to slow time and highlight things around you. It doesn't drain while you're not aiming, even when driving.
steps: White: doors and usable items. Red: enemies, explosives, alarms and weapons on the ground. Purple: drugs to sell. Green: cash.
On foot it lasts 30 seconds; when driving fast it can drop to about 10. While driving, police officers glow blue.

steps: Open the menu (Options on PS5, Menu on Xbox) and go to Settings; Control Scheme is the first tab.

title: Opening safes: codes, prying and sticky bombs
summary: Small safes often need no code: press Triangle/Y, then find the sweet spot with the right stick to pry them open. Bigger safes need a code you find nearby, or a sticky bomb.
steps: Sticky bombs open safes and locked doors without a code. Buy them at Ammu-Nation ($185 each) once you've finished the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check.
In Chapter 3 there's also a free crate of sticky bombs in the garage behind Yasmani's office.
You can carry four each, so eight when Jason and Lucia are together.

title: Meditation spots
summary: There are 18 meditation spots in Leonida; 15 count toward 100%. Some need a second visit.
steps: IGN says some spots need visiting once as a couple and again on your own; the map notes say once as Jason and once as Lucia.
Jason's House Meditation is Chapter 1 only: after a morning talk in the kitchen, follow Lucia to the balcony. Don't miss it.
The last one, Ascent Meditation, is in the stone circle at the top of Mount Kalaga.
Our map has 10 so far; they're in the Exploration checklist above.
